preRegistration.text:
# Pre-registration: WASP-67 b, MicroObservatory night of 2026-09-18 UT

SCAFFOLD from tools/mobs_night.py. Edit the judgment lines, then commit BEFORE any fit.

Frames: 72, 02:25 to 05:58 UT, 60.0 s Clear.
Archive (NEA pscomppars, fetched 2026-09-18 18:11 UTC): P 4.61442000 +/- 1.0e-05 d,
T0 2456618.053700 +/- 8.0e-05, T14 1.896 h, Rp/Rs 0.1379 (depth 1.90%), a/Rs 12.83,
inc 85.8, e 0.0, Teff 5200.0, V 12.537. Epoch 1015: predicted Tmid 2461301.69000 (04:33 UT),
ingress 03:36, egress 05:30; 71 min pre-ingress and 28 min post-egress in the window
(full). Propagated ephemeris bar 14.7 min.

Predictions:
- Sky judged by stars per frame and the target's aperture flux (night_triage), not the background.
  If the counts hold through 03:36-05:30 and the seed target is >200 ADU above background:
  QC PASS predicted. Reason: the cleanest night since TOI-3693 b 09-13 (70 of 72 frames clear, none lost, all 38 in-transit
  frames clear, target 453 ADU on the seed), and six comparisons at 4.0-7.4x the target, the first night the 0.15-8x
  comparison rule is tested from the passing side. If MARGINAL, expect it from the same place as 09-13: the short
  post-egress side (9 frames, 28 min) starving residual-flatness and duration, made worse here by b = 0.94, a
  near-grazing geometry whose duration is sensitive to small parameter shifts.
- Scatter, from the V-magnitude calibration (0.84% at V 11.57 on 2026-09-05, photon scaling):
  ~1.31%. On a 1.90% depth that is scatter/depth 0.69; with 0.425 giving
  8.2 min at ~3 min cadence, expected Tmid bar ~13 min (range 11-17).
  Under 8 min: calibration wrong the other way. Over 24 min: worse night than the counts show.
- Tmid within 1 sigma (that bar) of 2461301.69000. A miss beyond one bar on a night with no lost frames would NOT be
  the cloud-baseline bias seen on WASP-52 b and Qatar-4 b (there is no cloud to anchor on); it would point at the
  archive ephemeris itself, whose 14.7 min bar is almost entirely the period uncertainty (1.0e-05 d x 1015 epochs =
  14.6 min) propagated from a 2013 T0, i.e. a night that argues for a period update rather than a bad night. A miss
  by MORE than the ephemeris bar in the late direction, with a short post-egress baseline, is the one case where I
  would suspect the fit before the archive.
- Depth within 1 sigma of 1.90%; Rp/Rs within 1 sigma of 0.1379.
- If stars-per-frame falls by more than half at any point between 03:36 and 05:30, or the target is under
  ~200 ADU above background in the seed frame: expect FAIL or a rejected night, and the record will say so
  with no depth or timing claim.
- Any printed bar under 0.001 d is a replaced bar (#1401) and gets refit before the ledger.
- First-frame coordinates from a local plate solve; drift by star-pair voting; comps in the triage box within a
  brightness factor of the target; #1409 confirms the rest.
- Not submitted regardless; checkpoint holds.

parameters.Fit parameter point estimate: Best-fit likelihood point; uncertainties are posterior spread.
parameters.Prefit refinement note: Using an initial nested fit to estimate a transit duration of 0.122188 day(s), kept the full light curve because no extra baseline points fell outside the target window, and setting the second-pass Tmid bounds to [2461301.623305, 2461301.745493].
parameters.Pre-UltraNest LM boundary scout note: LM solution and covariance envelope were interior after 2 iteration(s).
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline parameter-fit no: only 5 pre-ingress and 6 post-egress out-of-transit point(s) were available; need more than 12 on each side to fit baseline parameters.
parameters.Out-of-transit baseline detrending note: Skipped; only 5 pre-ingress and 6 post-egress out-of-transit point(s) were available; need more than 12 on each side to fit a linear baseline.
parameters.Sparse posterior live-point extension no: Applied additive selected comparison-star final UltraNest extension (200->1200 minimum live points).
parameters.Final residual rejection note: No residual outliers exceeded 3.0 sigma from the iterated median residual (0.0907%, stdev=0.9144%).
parameters.Uncertainty interpretation note: The primary Rp/R* and radius-ratio area-depth uncertainties use model+red-noise when available. The red-noise uncertainty inflates the data-fit standard error by a residual time-binning beta factor before combining it with the model posterior. The flux baseline red-noise uncertainty is the out-of-transit baseline component used for the final-plot baseline band; the transit-depth red-noise uncertainty already includes both the in-transit and baseline terms. The same residual time-binning beta factor is applied to the posterior uncertainties for Tmid, a/Rs, inclination, and impact parameter when reporting their primary model+red-noise uncertainties. The flux-scatter equivalent is also shown as a diagnostic of the full residual scatter around the model.
